note: What sending this file to the site would BECOME — create, update, contribute, or the one way on, fork — and the publish button whole: its word, the line under it, and why it is closed when it is. Written because each product decided this on its own and none had the whole list: both clients announced Contribute over a translation whose author works alone, and the server said no after the upload. Null is 'not asked', never 'no'. Contributing and forking are decided in the game and nowhere else.
